title: Smol Blocks
subtitle: A short guide
text:
Cut basic solid blocks into slabs, vertical slabs, quarters and eighths with a saw, then place them and mix them together. Each piece keeps the textures of the block it was cut from, including modded blocks.

An eighth is 1/8 of a full block: half the width, depth and height. One block space can hold up to 8 eighths, and each one can come from a different source block.

Craft this book from a book and an iron nugget.

steps.title: Saws
steps.text: Craft an iron or diamond saw, then cut a block or piece in the crafting grid. The saw stays in the grid and loses durability.

steps.title: Cuts
steps.text: The saw's position sets a horizontal or vertical cut, from full blocks down to eighths.

steps.title: Placing
steps.text: Mix up to 8 pieces in one space. Each piece keeps the look of the block it came from.

steps.title: Precision pickaxes
steps.text: Break only the piece you are looking at. A normal tool breaks the whole space.

steps.title: Water and limits
steps.text: Build fish tanks from sealed glass faces. Some blocks cannot be cut, and pieces cannot be put back together.
